races.verdict: Preference is for RIVER TRIEUX , who bumped into a useful prospect at Cork second time up and Paddy Twomey's filly can leave her subsequent Fairyhouse effort behind dropped into claiming company. Joseph O'Brien saddles a couple and his recent C&D winner Eleanor Shelby rates as the main threat. Purely and Near Perfection can fight out third. RIVER TRIEUX ELEANOR SHELBY PURELY (IRE)

races.verdict: 4-time course winner MEHMAN did well to get as close as he did when fifth over C&D a fortnight ago and lurking on a dangerous mark, he gets the tentative vote to end a lengthy losing sequence in reapplied blinkers. Rappell arrives on the back of a string of placed efforts, so Paul Flynn's 5-y-o could emerge as the main danger, with Eichan San and Faoladh another couple to consider, as well. MEHMAN RAPPELL (IRE) EICHAN SAN (IRE)

races.verdict: Preference is for BOSTON MAX , who proved at least as good as ever when just edged out at this course 7 days ago. He can build on that effort to resume winning ways, though Blue Anthem isn't taken lightly having shaped well here on his recent stable debut. The Cosy Corner completes the shortlist. BOSTON MAX (IRE) BLUE ANTHEM THE COSY CORNER (IRE)

races.display_title: Renegade Brewery Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

races.verdict: COOLTOBECARELESS burst clear in the manner of one ready for a higher-grade 2m novice on his recent hurdling debut at Chepstow and is taken to provide his top trainer with a third consecutive win in this race. races.display_title: Chapel Down Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: LITTLE LEDGEND has thrived for the recent switch to chasing and can extend his unbeaten record to 3. Fellow novice Fairlawn Skipper made a winning chase bow in good style at Kelso last month and he looks the other potential improver in the field, while Unanswered Prayers is lurking on a dangerous mark on return. races.display_title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd January 2027 Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict: BATTLE STANDARD proved a different proposition switched to a handicap for the first time when bolting up at Southwell 8 days ago and escaping a penalty for that, he looks to hold serious claims again with the prospect of more to come. Palliser similarly improved a chunk on his first start in a handicap when second over C&D recently and he's feared. Ballybunion may well complete a clean sweep for the 3-y-os. Yehudi may emerge best of the rest. BATTLE STANDARD PALLISER BALLYBUNION (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Battle Standard (5/4), Yehudi (6/1), Palliser (6/1), Fools Rush In (10/1), Ballybunion (10/1), Book Of Life (10/1), Snaafy (16/1), Sant Alessio (16/1), Alessia Fernanda (20/1), Asian Journey (20/1), King Of Charm (50/1)

races.display_title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd January 2027 Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: Not for the first time of late, ERNIE'S VALENTINE shaped really well when posting a very good third at Southwell 2 weeks ago, travelling smoothly before paying the price for a big move into contention. Evidently down to a handy mark, he's selected to end a losing run. Tommo's Ginjaninja ran right up to his best when second at Redcar recently and he's a threat. Baloo's Blues and Typeface complete the shortlist. ERNIE'S VALENTINE TOMMO'S GINJANINJA BALOO'S BLUES
races.betting_forecast: Typeface (10/3), Baloo's Blues (9/2), Ernie's Valentine (6/1), Tommo's Ginjaninja (6/1), Mythical Isle (8/1), Under The Sun (8/1), Karakula Dancer (10/1), Vega Storm (12/1), Mr Tony (14/1), Union Island (25/1), San Juanito (33/1)

races.display_title: Midnite Aint Your Grandads Bookie Selling Handicap
races.verdict: JODHPUR BLUE has managed only one career victory but is a much more solid proposition on all-weather and took a step in the right direction at Southwell in first-time cheekpieces 8 days ago, so looks the pick in this lowly contest. Three-time course winner R P Mcmurphy produced a rare below-par effort last time but will be a threat if bouncing back and seeing out the longer trip, while Freddy Robinson can continue his consistent spell. JODHPUR BLUE (FR) R P MCMURPHY FREDDY ROBINSON

races.display_title: William Hill Price Boosts Every Day Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: Another fiendishly-competitive sprint in which it could pay to take a chance on GO VINCE GO , who has dropped to a career-low mark and Tim Easterby's 3-y-o promises to be suited by this return to 6f. Angel Gabriel took his form up a level when scoring at Windsor recently and having backed that up when third at Haydock since, he can provide most resistance. Almarada Prince and Lipsink round off the shortlist. GO VINCE GO (IRE) ANGEL GABRIEL (IRE) ALMARADA PRINCE (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Angel Gabriel (3/1), Almarada Prince (7/2), French Affair (6/1), Lipsink (8/1), Oriental Prince (10/1), Never Just A Dream (10/1), Wobwobwob (12/1), Intense Vision (14/1), Archduke Ferdinand (14/1), Mythical Phoenix (25/1), Go Vince Go (25/1), Jellystone Park (25/1), Kodiac Thriller (33/1)

races.verdict: BABY PEARL took a big step forward from her debut when second at Wexford 11 weeks ago and with the prospect of more to come, looks the way to go. Ronnie's Rascal is an obvious contender for Willie Mullins, while Casheldale Lass (behind the selection at Wexford) could be in the hunt again. BABY PEARL (IRE) RONNIE'S RASCAL (IRE) CASHELDALE LASS (IRE)
